### Country-specific policy context

<div class="country-policy-context"><p>Guidelines indicate that sometimes primaquine can be provided without G6PD testing given the low G6PDd prevalence and the delay that could occur for treatment if testing is not available at PoC. The dosage is not specified. In situation where PQ is administered with G6PD testing, the guidance says to closely monitor for haemolysis—particularly falling haemoglobin, dark/pigmented urine (색소뇨), and jaundice; 2019 guidelines: Adult: PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days, Paediatric: 0.3 mg/kg/day over 14 days - this distinction removed in following guidelines.</p></div>
